newsitem.title: USA: Dean Foods names Philip Marineau president.
newsitem.headline: Dean Foods names Philip Marineau president.

text.p: Dean Foods Co said Monday it named Philip Marineau as president and chief operating officer, effective December 6.
Marineau, former president and chief operating officer of Quaker Oats Co, also will serve on Dean Foods' board of directors.
Marineau replaces Thomas Rose, who stepped down as president and chief operating officer but was named vice chairman.
Marineau, 50, spent 23 years at Quaker Oats, resigning in October, 1995. At that time, Quaker Oats management said his resignation was the result of a drive for lean management.
Quaker Chairman William Smithburg assumed the president's title and responsibility for Snapple, the fruit and tea beverage line that has posted operating losses.
